title: Improving Feasibility in Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm for Vehicle Routing via Constraint-Aware Initialization and Hybrid XY-X Mixing
summary: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a leading framework for quantum combinatorial optimization. The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP), a core problem in logistics and transportation, is a natural application target, but it poses a major feasibility challenge for standard QAOA because feasible solutions occupy only a tiny fraction of the search space, and the conventional Pauli-$X$ mixer can disrupt partial solution structures that satisfy key local constraints.
